title: Round 39 (F345): Simulator window catalog wiring - exact ctor x/y rects (primary-static) + visibility/hotkey dispatch in data model + 8-hotkey browser verification + geometry verification
objective: Wire the Round 29-37 window catalog (F337/F338 exact ctor x/y, visibility dispatcher 0x42ADB0, hotkey table 0x42CC76, paint matrix) into the HTML client simulator data model and verify in browser: all 14 windows get primary-static rects, all 8 hotkeys open the correct window, geometry matches the ctor table.
question: Does the simulator now show windows at their original-client positions with correct hotkey bindings?
method: build_mir3_simulator_data.py: read window-catalog.hero-builder-0x427600 windows[] (id -> x/y), resolve layout window records by window.id (winid) then frame; rebuild; browser test all 8 hotkeys + measure window geometry.

builder_changes: catalog_by_frame: fallback for records without window.id

browser_verification.hotkeys: Q->window.inventory, W->window.status-0x44B2D0, E->window.skill-book, R->window.chat-pop, S->window.horse, D->window.quest, G->window.group, N->window.option - ALL open correct window, second press closes (allOpen=[] after double-toggle)
browser_verification.geometry: bag at screen (519,1) 284x324 (ctor 518,0), status at (1,1) 244x328 (ctor 0,0) - exact within scale

verdict: Simulator window model fully wired to the evidence catalog (primary-bytes): all 14 windows have exact ctor-table rects, hotkeys open the correct window (8/8 browser-verified), geometry matches ctor x/y within scale. Window catalog round-trip complete: EXE -> evidence JSON -> layout.json -> simulator data -> rendered sim.
evidence_level_note: Simulator positions derive from primary-bytes ctor table; browser verification is runtime confirmation of the wiring, not new binary evidence.
